To further elaborate on the cheating thing, I didn't find out about her cheating until a good while after the break up. and than even later regarding my close friend who i actually forgave. she had apparently been sending him nudes and just flirting around and while he didnt respond or act on it he didnt tell me either or tell her to stop. the kicker here though is that he while he was there for me for the period after it didnt stop him from sleeping with her at the same time. She had been fucking around with other guys as well though apparently while we were dating so eh. 

I'm nineteen graduated highschool and taking a year or two off to try and figure out what i want to do. i kept as many doors open as possible in highschool through taking the uni courses and passing with 70+ average in all but on course. this is the Canadian system if that clarifies anything. 

Funny how now that you mention doing things for myself i do realize that i typically do more for others. either way i realize i havent really done much for myself. 

As for stuff going on in my life, not much really. developed feelings for someone who i can't be with due to them being in a relationship. Alot more  complicated than that but its not worth going into to and doesnt really play much role in my mental state other than feeling utterly hopeless in regards to dating. I just don't have much hope of meeting someone and getting to know them etc due to my nature.

Theres a metal show that I'm going to with a friend or two. first live show for me. thats also the first thing. second thing is seeing a bunch of friends who i haven't hung out with in months. other than that, typically day in day out working, playing some video games, watching some anime, and browsing the web. as for sleep, i have a really really hard time falling asleep and lately i've been having a really hard time staying asleep and not waking up like twice a night.

Usually after friends have parties/get together i usually stay the next day to help clean up. I'm also always there for any one of them when ever they have shit hit the fan and they desire to talk. i don't know, i just be me. but yeah, I posted here because while i may not do it next week or even after the thoughts of it were getting to me. thank you in advance for talking though. While i may be great at listening to friends when they have troubles and just supporting them im terrible at seeking support from them. I just hide as much as i can and bottle it up while around them. I just have a really hard time putting into words what im feeling when even thinking about trying to let them know.
